properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive devDependency: selfsigned@2.4.1 (yarn.lock:6827) uses node-forge to mint self-signed X.509 dev certs for webpack-dev-server's HTTPS option; webpack.config.js:15 sets devServer https:false, so the capability is installed but this dev server runs plain HTTP. properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 is the curve this dapp actually exercises: six components call @metamask/eth-sig-util recoverTypedSignature/recoverPersonalSignature (secp256k1 ecRecover), and every eth_signTypedData/personal_sign result the dapp verifies is secp256k1 ECDSA. The native secp256k1@4 package under ethereumjs-util@5.1.1 (yarn.lock:6813, lavamoat policy package.json:78) is a second implementation of the same curve in the tree. Replaceable only by an Ethereum protocol change, not by this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The MAC/authentication half of the same live nacl.box call as ALG-1138d04b: the 'x25519-xsalsa20-poly1305' suite derives a one-time Poly1305 key via XSalsa20 from the X25519 agreement and authenticates the encrypted message. Symmetric authenticator — not itself Shor-broken, but part of the same suite string and the same migration unit (the version literal selects the whole package). Companion: ALG-f58a8f00 (XSalsa20-Poly1305, yarn.lock, scout 1) and LIB-0469707e (tweetnacl) cover the implementat

properties.name: pqs:context

Exercisable at runtime only through the @web3modal→@coinbase/wallet-sdk→@solana/web3.js chain (Solana keypairs/signatures are Ed25519). Presence is the inventory question; use was not established from this tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live crypto asset, the most PQ-relevant one in this repo. The MetaMask test-dapp's Encrypt/Decrypt panel calls encrypt() from @metamask/eth-sig-util with version 'x25519-xsalsa20-poly1305'; eth-sig-util generates an ephemeral X25519 keypair and runs nacl.box (tweetnacl, pinned in yarn.lock) against the public key returned by the wallet's eth_getEncryptionPublicKey — classic harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure for off-chain messages. The dapp pairs it with eth_decrypt RPC (wallet-side). Changeable

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.6.1 (yarn.lock:3624) is ethers 5.7.2's secp256k1 backend, and the forced ^6.6.1 resolution is itself a recorded security decision worth keeping visible. The dapp imports ethers (src/utils.js:1, src/index.js:2), so ECDSA ships in the browser bundle; the app's own signature verification goes through eth-sig-util/@noble instead.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live in the app, not just a dependency: src/components/encryption/encrypt-decrypt.js:1 imports { encrypt } from '@metamask/eth-sig-util' and lines 133-137 call encrypt({ version: 'x25519-xsalsa20-poly1305', ... }) — eth-sig-util implements that with tweetnacl.box (ephemeral X25519 + XSalsa20-Poly1305). Harvest-now-decrypt-later: captured ciphertexts become readable once a CRQC exists. The wallet counterpart is eth_getEncryptionPublicKey (encrypt-decrypt.js:104).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: scrypt-js@3.0.1 (Percival's scrypt KDF port) ships as a transitive dependency via ethers 5.7.2's json-wallets module (keystore derivation). Library view: LIB-73d70f43 (scrypt-js, scout 1).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: This is the hash the app actually exercises: eth-sig-util's recoverTypedSignature/recoverPersonalSignature (called from six dapp components) compute the EIP-712/EIP-191 digest with Keccak-256 before secp256k1 recovery, and ethereumjs-util's toChecksumAddress (permit-sign.js:135, signTypedDataV4-sign.js:193) hashes addresses with Keccak-256 for EIP-55. Quantum relevance is Grover-limited (preimage security halves), not Shor-broken.

Same package as ALG-c57b2423 (ChaCha20-Poly1305 view) and LIB-f169d8e1 (library view).

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The DEM half of the app's EIP-1024 encryption: encrypt-decrypt.js:133-137 calls eth-sig-util encrypt({ version: 'x25519-xsalsa20-poly1305' }). properties.name: pqs:context
